subject: Post-demo: usage profile, $/1M target & Founders sponsorship request
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@makerai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: usage profile, $/1M target & Founders sponsorship request

Hey Samir — thanks again for the demo today, appreciate you walking Alex and me through the ingestion flow and inference checkpoints. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

Key takeaways
- Expected active users: 12–18k MAU, heavy read-only queries + 2k daily writes (annotations).
- Token profile (90th percentile): ~950 tokens/request; anticipated steady-state throughput 80–120M tokens/day after month 3.
- Current runway / budget range you shared: target $45k–$70k / month for infra (we heard $0.9M–1.2M annual spend target range).

Primary asks
1) Can you confirm whether the $/1M token target you referenced was $650–$800 or $550–$650? We want to align discount tiers to your expectation.
2) Would MakerAI be open to a 12‑month committed plan (soft commit with monthly true‑ups) in exchange for a Founder Sponsorship credit and an additional 20% off our list committed rate for first 6 months?
3) Can we get a single point of contact for procurement/internal legal so we can send a short MSA/MAA and accelerate signature?

Attachments: I dropped a quick token burn estimate (post-demo-usage-estimate.xlsx) and a one-page Founder Sponsorship outline (founder-sponsor-offer.pdf). Also included a draft MAA for procurement to skim (MAA-draft-Redwood.pdf).

Next steps
- If you can confirm the $/1M range and preferred commit length by Thursday EOD PST, I’ll circulate the signed offer + DocuSign link.
- Ben will follow up with a compact committed-use term sheet that maps hours/slots to expected latency SLAs.

Thanks — keen to get MakerAI into our Founder program if the economics make sense.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
Attachment stubs: post-demo-usage-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet), founder-sponsor-offer.pdf (pdf), MAA-draft-Redwood.pdf (pdf)

From: Samir Patel <samir@makerai.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@makerai.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: usage profile, $/1M target & Founders sponsorship request

Hannah — great summary, thanks. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- The $/1M token target I mentioned on the call was in the $600–$700 range per 1M tokens once we hit steady state. Early months will be higher (we expect a 3–4x ramp).
- The team is definitely interested in a 12‑month committed plan if there’s a realistic path to the founder credit — the founders sponsor program is appealing because it offsets the initial spike.
- Procurement + Legal: that’s me + Alex for now; I’ll loop in finance if we move to an LOI.

Two asks from us: 
1) Can you send a simple committed-use example (what 12‑month spend looks like vs. month-to-month) with the discount baked in? A table that shows projected token bands and net $/1M after credits would be ideal.
2) How quickly can you guarantee latency SLOs for the peak 90th percentile? We’re sensitive to spikes during batch ingestion.

If you can get the term sheet today we’ll try to align internally and respond by Friday.

—Samir
Co-founder, MakerAI
samir@makerai.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: MakerAI committed-use math and SLA note

Quick internal note (hannah, marissa) — looping our pricing ops and SRE on the expected throughput. Initial draft numbers I’ll push to the shared sheet: 
- Baseline list price we model: $1,200 / 1M tokens (on-hosted midsize model).
- Proposed Founder net: we can target $650 / 1M with a 12mo committed band at 50% of their expected first-year volume recognized monthly (soft true‑up).
- Sponsorship credit: $60k one‑time starter credit applied evenly across first 6 billing cycles -> effectively brings month-1 and month-2 $/1M down ~35–45% depending on ramp.
- SLA: SRE says 95th p50 latency hold under dedicated pool; for 90th percentile spikes during ingestion we recommend enabling auto-burst into dedicated pool (adds ~5–10% cost but guarantees <200ms p90 for token lengths described).

I’ll attach a simple committed-use example to the Hub link and Hannah can share with Samir. If this is approved, I’ll ask finance to generate an MRR schedule for legal.

—Ben
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: usage profile, $/1M target & Founders sponsorship request

Samir — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming the $600–$700 band. Per Ben’s internal note (pasted below), we can do the following proposal: 

Proposal (summary)
- Length: 12 months committed-use (monthly recognition with soft true-ups).
- Founder Sponsorship: $60k one-time credit applied across first 6 invoices.
- Effective net rate: target $650 / 1M tokens once ramp is steady (month 4+).
- Month-1 example: with credit applied and expected ramp, net effective $/1M = ~$420 (attached committed-use-example.xlsx demonstrates scenarios).
- SLA path: enable dedicated pool + auto-burst for ingestion windows; expected p90 <200ms with small burst premium.

Next steps
1) I’ve attached the committed-use example (committed-use-example.xlsx) and an offer PDF (founder-sponsor-offer.pdf). Please review the simple table mapping token bands -> net rate.
2) If that aligns, I’ll send an MAA + DocuSign link for signature (we can make the founder credit effective on execution).
3) Can you confirm procurement contact for legal redlines? You mentioned you + Alex for now — if you want I can add Finance (name: Priya Natarajan) to the chain to speed approval.

If this looks good I’ll route to legal and DocuSign today so we can get you onboarded next week.

Best,
Hannah
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
